findings.explanation: Payment terms of Net 40 mean you will wait longer than 30 days to receive your money, which can negatively affect your cash flow.
Payment is due in 40 days, which exceeds the standard 30-day threshold.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few small adjustments before signing. - Regarding the clause 'Invoices are payable Net 40.', payment terms of Net 40 mean you will wait longer than 30 days to receive your money, which can negatively affect your cash flow; please update this to 'Invoices are payable Net 30.' Best regards.
